Into the midst of this sunless mood came a surprise Right before me, in my steady but aimless track across the waste, was a clump of dwarf trees, poor, puny things that must have had a hard coming-up. arxiv-1909-09397.title: Simulating Crowds in Real Time with Agent-Based Modelling and a Particle Filter Thanks: This project has received funding from the European Research Council (ERC) under the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme (grant agreement No. 757455), through a UK Economic and Social
arxiv-1909-09397.creator: Nick Malleson, Kevin Minors, Le-Minh Kieu, Jonathan A. Ward, Andrew A. West, Alison Heppenstall
arxiv-1909-09397.description: Abstract Agent-based modelling is a valuable approach for systems whose behaviour is driven by the interactions between distinct entities. They have shown particular promise as a means of modelling crowds of people in streets, public transport terminals, stadiums, etc. However, the methodology faces a fundamental difficulty: there are no established mechanisms for dynamically incorporating real-time data into models.

arxiv-2001-09973.title: A Sharper Image: The Quest of Science and Recursive Production of Objective Realities
arxiv-2001-09973.creator: Julio Michael Stern
arxiv-2001-09973.description: Abstract This article explores the metaphor of Science as provider of sharp images of our environment, using the epistemological framework of Objective Cognitive Constructivism. These sharp images are conveyed by precise scientific hypotheses that, in turn, are encoded by mathematical equations.

arxiv-2102-03847.title: Entanglement in Cognition violating Bell Inequalities Beyond Cirel’son’s Bound Center Leo Apostel for Interdisciplinary Studies, Free University of Brussels (VUB), Krijgskundestraat 33, 1160 Brussels, Belgium; email addresses: diraerts@vub.ac.be,lestercc21@gmail.com,sgeriente83@yahoo.com School of B
arxiv-2102-03847.creator: Diederik Aerts, Jonito Aerts Arguëlles, Lester Beltran
arxiv-2102-03847.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Diederik Aerts, Jonito Aerts Arguëlles, Lester Beltran. We present the results of two tests where a sample of human participants were asked to make judgements about the conceptual combinations The Animal Acts and The Animal eats the Food . Both tests significantly violate the Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt version of Bell inequalities (‘CHSH inequality’), thus exhibiting manifestly non-classical behaviour due to the meaning connection between the individual concepts that are combined.

arxiv-2203-13655.title: Gransformer: Transformer-based Graph Generation
arxiv-2203-13655.creator: Ahmad Khajenezhad, Seyed Ali Osia, Mahmood Karimian, Hamid Beigy
arxiv-2203-13655.description: Abstract Transformers have become widely used in various tasks, such as natural language processing and machine vision. This paper proposes Gransformer, an algorithm based on Transformer for generating graphs. We modify the Transformer encoder to exploit the structural information of the given graph.

arxiv-2205-00727.description: Abstract The feasibility of shielding axial magnetic fields up to 1.4 T, using a Bi-2212 hollow cylinder, is investigated at a temperature of 4.2 K. The residual magnetic flux density along the axis of the tube is measured at external fields of 1 T and 1.4 T.

It is customary to denote the maximal value of these determinants by \alpha_{m} .

arxiv-2306-08956.title: Multi-Loss Convolutional Network with Time-Frequency Attention for Speech Enhancement
arxiv-2306-08956.creator: 1 st Liang Wan, 2 nd Hongqing Liu, 3 rd Yi Zhou, 4 rd Jie Jia
arxiv-2306-08956.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by 1 st Liang Wan, 2 nd Hongqing Liu, 3 rd Yi Zhou, 4 rd Jie Jia. The Dual-Path Convolution Recurrent Network (DPCRN) was proposed to effectively exploit time-frequency domain information. By combining the DPRNN module with Convolution Recurrent Network (CRN), the DPCRN obtained a promising performance in speech separation with a limited model size. In this paper, we explore self-attention in the DPCRN module and design a model called Multi-Loss Convolutional Network with Time-Frequency Attention(MNTFA) for speech enhancement.

arxiv-2306-15639.title: Radiation of Optical Angular Momentum from a Dipole Source in a Magneto-birefringent disordered Environment
arxiv-2306-15639.creator: R. Le Fournis, B.A. van Tiggelen
arxiv-2306-15639.description: Abstract Abstract : We investigate the radiation of optical angular momentum by a dipole gas under uniform magnetic field with an unpolarized source at its center. Conservation of angular momentum implies a torque on both the source and the surrounding environment. We study the separate spin and orbital contributions to the radiated angular momentum.

arxiv-2503-23516.title: Unconditionally Energy Stable Second Order Numerical Scheme for a Microemulsion model
arxiv-2503-23516.creator: Natasha S. Sharma, Giordano Tierra
arxiv-2503-23516.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Natasha S. Sharma, Giordano Tierra. We present a numerical scheme for solving a sixth-order Cahn-Hilliard type equation that captures the dynamics of phase transitions in a ternary mixture consisting of two immiscible fluids and a surface active molecule that is amphiphilic. We show that by considering a suitable midpoint approximation for the nonlinear terms in the differential equation, we obtain an unconditionally energy-stable numerical scheme that is second-order in time.

arxiv-2503-24382.title: Free360: Layered Gaussian Splatting for Unbounded 360-Degree View Synthesis from Extremely Sparse and Unposed Views
arxiv-2503-24382.creator: Chong Bao, Xiyu Zhang, Zehao Yu, Jiale Shi, Guofeng Zhang, Songyou Peng, Zhaopeng Cui
arxiv-2503-24382.description: Abstract Neural rendering has demonstrated remarkable success in high-quality 3D neural reconstruction and novel view synthesis with dense input views and accurate poses. However, applying it to extremely sparse, unposed views in unbounded 360 ∘ scenes remains a challenging problem.

arxiv-2504-04149.title: Erbium-doped lithium niobate waveguide amplifier enhanced by an inverse-designed on-chip reflector Journal: opticajournal
arxiv-2504-04149.creator: Zhiwei Wei, Jiangwei Wu, Chengyu Chen, Hao Li, Wenjie Wan, Xianfeng Chen, Yuping Chen
arxiv-2504-04149.description: Abstract This study presents a 3.6-cm-long erbium-doped lithium niobate waveguide amplifier enhanced by an inverse-designed on-chip reflector. Integrating the reflector at the waveguide end yielded an internal net gain of 40.5 dB, achieving a 17.3 dB gain improvement compared to a comparable reflector-free amplifier under small signal conditions. By eliminating bidirectional pumping requirements, the system complexity was reduced.

pmc-11709824.description: BackgroundThe limited treatment options for Alzheimer’s emphasizes the need to explore novel drug targets and bring new therapeutics to market. Agomelatine (AGO) was identified by a high‐throughput drug screening algorithm as having mechanistic potential to treat Alzheimer’s.

pmc-12562206.description: Background: Cancer treatments can damage the ovaries, with implications for fertility and reproductive lifespan. The debate is currently open as to whether the ovarian reserve may already be reduced before exposure to anticancer therapy.

pmc-13134389.description: ObjectiveSocioeconomic inequalities in access to dental care remain a critical public health challenge in Spain, where adult coverage is limited and largely financed through out-of-pocket payments. pmc-13354446.title: Intravascular Large B-Cell Lymphoma Diagnosed on Gastroesophageal Junction Biopsy During Evaluation of Dysphagia
pmc-13354446.creator: Rowan Bandaranaike, Beth Rutland, Travis Rutland, Adam Edwards
pmc-13354446.description: Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma is a rare aggressive lymphoma confined to small-vessel lumina that may elude endoscopic detection. Diagnosis from a gastroesophageal junction biopsy is rarely reported. A 75-year-old woman underwent upper endoscopy for dysphagia, revealing only an irregular Z-line. Histopathology demonstrated CD20-positive atypical lymphoid cells within submucosal vessel lumina, suspicious for intravascular large B-cell lymphoma.
